Shiinotic

Grass Fairy

Alola · Generation 7

Shiinotic is a Grass/Fairy-type Illuminating Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 11.5 kg. It evolves from Morelull. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (100), with a base stat total of 405.
